cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your bottled cloud the centrepiece of the garden show. It made one drop. Bring the display stand.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wanted a whole shower for the seedlings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A drop reached a leaf. We'll put that seedling beside the bottle; I'll carry the stand.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You turned the label round. It says 'last drop.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll water them today. Bring your notebook; we'll work out how big a cloud would wet the whole tray.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs B project display, A3 uses a wet leaf as evidence and carries the stand while hiding the last-drop label; A5 takes watering so B can plan a larger cloud.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 shower goal makes A3 wet leaf relevant; B4 finite last drop changes A5 from reusing the exhausted bottle to estimating the scale needed for a tray.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the project to water seedlings and B4 exposes A concealed limit, both relevant to whether to continue.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses the finite small result as a planning unit rather than asking the same bottle to repeat an unsupported success.

specificity.evidence: A1 bottled cloud, show and one drop, B2 seedlings and B4 warning make the unusual goal and its shortfall explicit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 watering offer and notebook calculation request support the same practical continuation without a declaration about keeping hope alive.
